purpose: Define explicit lifecycle and source-role semantics for canonical definitions without allowing version, status, or physical file coexistence to create ambiguity.

topics.name: Canonical Lifecycle

operations.name: Validate Canonical Lifecycle
errors: multiple active definitions for one identity
historical definition treated as active by file presence
breaking semantic change under unchanged identity

rules: only explicitly active definitions participate in the active semantic graph
superseded/deprecated/historical definitions remain traceable but do not compete with active identity resolution
a breaking semantic change creates a new identity rather than silently redefining the old identity

invariants.rule: Machine-significant meaning is represented explicitly and is not reconstructed by hidden heuristics.

hard_gates.condition: multiple active definitions for one identity
historical definition treated as active by file presence
breaking semantic change under unchanged identity
